grammar.title: 给...打电话 for calling someone
grammar.explanation: 打电话 (dǎ diànhuà) means "to make a phone call". To say who you're calling, insert 给 + person right before it: 我给你打电话 ("I'll call you"). Don't put the person directly before 打电话 without 给.

sentences.zh: 他一到家就打电话给我。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yī dào jiā jiù dǎ diànhuà gěi wǒ.
sentences.en: As soon as he got home, he called me.

sentences.zh: 他一边吃饭，一边看电视。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yìbiān chīfàn, yìbiān kàn diànshì.
Tā yìbiān zǒu, yìbiān dǎ diànhuà.
sentences.en: She walks while making a phone call.
